grouped.rule: delegates_to rows under 1,000 NEAR staked by lockups (backer class lockup): one group row per pool
delegates_to rows under 1,000 NEAR staked by liquid-staking contracts (backer class liquid): one group row per pool

delegates_to rows under 1,000 NEAR staked by other delegators (backer class other): one group row per pool

coverage.note: All known staking pools are participants (pool.near/poolv1.near factory list from NearBlocks plus anything in RPC validators/proposals/kickouts). Delegators were crawled with get_accounts for every non-idle pool; the 424 idle pools (no seat, no proposal; ~6656 delegation records holding very little stake) were not crawled and their delegators are missing. Delegation rows with zero staked and zero unstaked were dropped. Liquid-staking contracts (Meta Pool, LiNEAR, ...) appear as delegators to many pools; their own token holders are NOT listed (that would need their contract state or token-holder APIs). Pool identities are self-declared in pool-details.near (via NearBlocks). A named .near account id is a self-declared identity, not a verified one. Lockup contracts (*.lockup.near) are marked account_type=lockup; their owners were not resolved. participants_total = included + idle-pool delegation records (approx.). Pool owners (get_owner_id) are included as kind unknown. Petal import: 8,319 of 286,088 delegates_to rows (98.76% of the stake they carry) have at least 1,000 NEAR staked and stay individual; the rest are folded into 565 group rows, one per pool and backer class (coverage.grouped). Small delegators appear only inside those groups. Backer classes: lockup (lockup contracts), liquid (liquid-staking contracts), large (1,000,000+ NEAR staked across all pools), other.
